subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should maintainers require live Codex app-server proof for this `exec_command` warning fix, or explicitly accept source-contract inspection plus focused OpenClaw tests as sufficient?
rationale: ClawSweeper's external-PR gate requires real behavior proof, and source inspection found remaining producer-path uncertainty because current OpenClaw projects `commandExecution` items to `bash`.

options.title: Require live Codex proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or a recording showing both read-only suppression and mutating-warning behavior after the branch is refreshed.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the sibling Codex source contract plus targeted OpenClaw tests despite the missing live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Pause or close this PR if no live or producer-path evidence can show raw `exec_command` reaches this warning policy on current OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Require live Codex proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or a recording showing both read-only suppression and mutating-warning behavior after the branch is refreshed.
